summary: The proof is sequentially valid. The Minkowski-convex-hull and mixed-area identities are correct; the whole-body R-cell charge yields the stated necessary budget and dominates the predecessor endpoint-plus-slab budget; and both rational calibration families have the claimed exact Q-supports, areas, slab bound, midpoint compatibility, and strict inequality for every integer n at least 3. The constructions are correctly limited to partial common-plane configurations and are not asserted to satisfy the crossings, tails, or W=0.
